title: Default Revocation
description:
default-revocation/v2 — the document a default-revocation event carries. Emitted by the same role that asserted a prior default-notice, to deactivate the unilateral seizure authorization it activated (e.g. a cure of the underlying default). Only a same-role revocation clears the condition — the account policy's asserter check is scoped by emitter role, not by which party within the role acted.

The document is informational: the definition's guard asks only who is emitting and when.

conditionName.description: The account policy condition this revocation deactivates — 'default' for every container the facade provisions today.

reason.description: Why the assertion is withdrawn, e.g. the missed obligation was cured. Free text for the audit trail.
